title: Kindergarten Math Quiz
description: Ten gentle questions for kindergarteners: counting to 20, shapes, more and less, and adding small groups, with friendly explanations.

questions.question: You count: 12, 13, 14. What number comes next?
questions.explanation: Count one more after 14: 12, 13, 14, 15. The next number is 15.

questions.question: There are 3 red apples and 2 green apples. How many apples are there altogether?
questions.explanation: Add the two groups: 3 + 2 = 5. There are 5 apples altogether.

questions.question: Which number is bigger: 9 or 14?
questions.explanation: 14 comes after 9 when you count, so 14 is bigger.

questions.question: Which shape has 3 straight sides?
questions.explanation: A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. A circle has no straight sides at all.

questions.question: You have 8 crayons. You give 3 to a friend. How many crayons do you have now?
questions.explanation: Take away 3 from 8: 8 − 3 = 5. You have 5 crayons left.

questions.question: Which group has MORE: 6 cookies or 4 cookies?
questions.explanation: 6 is more than 4, so the group of 6 cookies has more.

questions.question: Count by tens: 10, 20, ___. What comes next?
questions.explanation: Counting by tens adds 10 each time: 10, 20, 30.

questions.question: Which number comes right AFTER 17?
questions.explanation: After 17 comes 18. Watch out for 71 — it looks like 17 backwards!

questions.question: There are 5 ducks in the pond. 2 more ducks swim over. How many ducks are there now?
questions.explanation: Add the new ducks: 5 + 2 = 7 ducks in all.

questions.question: Which shape is round like a ball?
questions.explanation: A circle is perfectly round with no corners, just like a ball looks from the side.
